title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Morgan McKinley is looking for an experienced, Accounts Assistant to work for a well established company in Horsham, West Sussex area. This a great job opportunity for someone with proven transactional finance experience to support the FC, dealing with everyday purchase ledger, sales ledger and month end duties, that is also keen to study and progress their accounting career!

Location: Office based - Horsham, West Sussex

Hours: Monday to Friday 9-5

Accounts Assistant duties:
- Process purchase invoices and prepare the payment run
- Raise and control the issue of purchase orders
- Bank account and balance sheet reconciliations
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date supplier records
- Assist with analysing the management accounts and month end
- Support with audits

Skills and experience:
- Experience working in a similar Accounts Assistant / Finance Assistant type role and keen to progress
- Ideally be AAT qualified or an keen to study ACCA / CIMA
- Excellent communication and IT skills
